subject: Switch to a tab when selectInput value changed

messages.author: d17eed8c529753ab
messages.subject: Switch to a tab when selectInput value changed
parts:
I want to render custom plots when a user selects plot type  but I need this action to automatically switch to a specific tab in the tabset panel. Here is my UI.R

mainPanel(
    tabsetPanel(
      tabPanel("Danger Signs",plotOutput("histPlot"),downloadButton('histPng','PNG'),downloadButton('histPdf','PDF')),
      tabPanel("Malaria Measures",verbatimTextOutput("siteName"),
                  plotOutput("piePlot"),
                  downloadButton('piePng', 'PNG'),
                  downloadButton('piePdf','PDF')
               ),
      tabPanel("Pneumonia Indicators",verbatimTextOutput("error"),plotOutput("timeSeriesPlot"),downloadButton('timeSeriesPng','PNG'),downloadButton('timeSeriesPdf','PDF')),
      tabPanel("Dehydration",plotOutput("boxPlot"),downloadButton('boxPng','PNG'),downloadButton('boxPdf','PDF')),
      tabPanel("Malnutrition",plotOutput("violinPlot"),downloadButton('violinPng','PNG'),downloadButton('violinPdf','PDF')),
      tabPanel("Data Table",
               checkboxInput(inputId = "pageable", label = "Pageable"),
               conditionalPanel("input.pageable==true",
                                numericInput(inputId = "pagesize",
                                             label = "Indicators per page",10)),
               htmlOutput("table"),
               downloadButton('datasetDownload','Download')),   
    tabPanel("Custom Plot",
             plotOutput("customPlot"),
             downloadButton('customPlotPng','PNG'),
             downloadButton('customPlotPdf','PDF'))
    )
  )

my server.R

# Define server logic required to generate and plot a random distribution
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
 
  site <- NULL
  observe({
    if (input$customPlot == 0) #check if this is first run
      return()
   
    isolate({
      # Read inputs and save values to database here
    })
  })
 
  #pageable options for googleVis table
  myOptions <- reactive({
    list(
      page=ifelse(input$pageable==TRUE,'enable','disable'),
      pageSize=input$pagesize,
      width=700
    )
  })
 
  graph<- renderText({ as.character(input$graphType) }) #graph type
  site <- renderText({as.character(input$hospital)}) #site (facility name)
  indicatorList <- reactive({ as.vector(input$indicators) }) #indicators as user input
 
  #the table with all the indicators and sites
  output$table <- renderGvis({   
    gvisTable(dataFrameSubsetByIndicators(),options=myOptions())
  })
 
  #downloads data or subsets of data
  output$datasetDownload <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() { paste("dataset", '.csv', sep='') },
    content = function(file) {     
      write.csv(dataFrameSubsetByIndicators(),file,row.names=FALSE)
    }
  )
 
  #download plots as pdf or png
  downloadPlots <- function(fileName,plotFunction,fileFormat,fileContentType){
    if(fileFormat=="pdf"){ #because it doesn't require specification of contentType. Others do
      downloadHandler(
        filename = fileName,
        content = function(file) {         
          pdf(file, pointsize = 12, bg = "white", paper = "a4")
          FUN <- match.fun(plotFunction)
          FUN()
          dev.off()
      })
    }else{
      downloadHandler(
        filename = fileName,
        content = function(file) {
          if(fileFormat=="png")
            png(file, pointsize = 12, bg = "white", res = NA)
          FUN <- match.fun(plotFunction)
          FUN()
          dev.off()
        },contentType = fileContentType)
    }
  }
 
  #render download plot buttons tied to their events
  #passes params to the download plot function
  output$histPng <- downloadPlots("histogram.png",histogram,"png","image/png") 
  output$histPdf <- downloadPlots("histogram.pdf",histogram,"pdf") 
  output$piePng <- downloadPlots("pie.png",pie,"png","image/png") 
  output$piePdf <- downloadPlots("pie.pdf",pie,"pdf") 
  output$boxPng <- downloadPlots("box.png",box,"png","image/png") 
  output$boxPdf <- downloadPlots("box.pdf",box,"pdf") 
  output$violinPng <- downloadPlots("violin.png",violin,"png","image/png") 
  output$violinPdf <- downloadPlots("violin.pdf",violin,"pdf") 
  output$timeSeriesPng <- downloadPlots("series.png",timeSeries,"png","image/png") 
  output$timeSeriesPdf <- downloadPlots("series.pdf",timeSeries,"pdf")
 
  #KEMRI wellcome Trust programme logo
  output$logo <- renderImage({
    filename <- 'logo.png'
    list(src = filename,
         contentType = 'image/png',
         width = 272,
         height = 153,
         alt = "KEMRI-Wellcome Trust Programme")
     
  }, deleteFile = FALSE)
 
  # Expression that generates a plot of the distribution. The expression
  # is wrapped in a call to renderPlot to indicate that:
  #
  #  1) It is "reactive" and therefore should be automatically
  #     re-executed when inputs change
  #  2) Its output type is a plot
  #
  output$piePlot <- renderPlot({   
    pie()
  }) 
  output$histPlot <- renderPlot({
    histogram()   
  }) 
  output$boxPlot <- renderPlot({
    box()
  }) 
  output$violinPlot <- renderPlot({
    violin()
  }) 
  output$timeSeriesPlot <- renderPlot({   
    timeSeries()
  })
 
  output$plotmatrix <- renderPlot({
    plotCombination()
  })
 
  #function to subset the data dynamically depending on the user input
  dataFrameSubsetByIndicators <- function(){
   
    sub <- dataset
   
    if(site()!="All")
      sub <- subset(sub,select=c("Indicators",site()))
   
    if(exists("indicatorList()") || length(indicatorList()!=0L)){
      if(!("All" %in% indicatorList())){
        mirror <-sub[0,]
        for(i in indicatorList()){         
          temp <- subset(sub,Indicators==as.character(i))       
          mirror <- rbind( mirror,temp )             
        }
        sub <- mirror
      }
    }else{
      mirror <-sub[0,]
      sub <- mirror
    }    
    return(sub)
  }
 
  #function to plot graph depending on the user selection. This is where you add more custom plot functions
  #that you can pass params to render the graph
  drawGraph <- function (graphType,dataFrame,xVariable,xLabel,yVariable,yLabel,legendTitle,groupVariable) {
    #check graph type
    if(!is.null(xVariable)){
      if(is.factor(xVariable)){
        graphX <- factor(xVariable)
      }else{
        graphX <- as.factor(xVariable)
      }
      graphY <- yVariable
    }       
   
    if(graphType=="hist"){
      if(is.null(yVariable)){
        c <- ggplot(dataFrame, aes(x=graphX, fill=graphX),environment=environment())
        print(c + geom_bar(width = .8)+ xlab(xLabel)+ylab(yLabel)+ coord_flip()+ labs(fill=legendTitle))
      }else{
        c <- ggplot(dataFrame, aes(x=graphX,y=graphY, fill=graphX),environment=environment())
        print(c + geom_bar(width = .8,stat="identity")+ xlab(xLabel)+ylab(yLabel)+ coord_flip()+ labs(fill=legendTitle))
      }     
    }else if(graphType=="box"){     
      c <- ggplot(dataFrame, aes(graphX,graphY),environment=environment())
      print(c + geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = "green", outlier.size = 3,aes(fill = xVariable))+ xlab(xLabel)+ylab(yLabel)+ labs(fill=legendTitle))     
    }else if(graphType=="series"){
      c <- ggplot(dataFrame, aes(group=factor(groupVariable),x=xVariable,y=yVariable),environment=environment())      
      print(c + geom_line(aes(colour = factor(groupVariable)),size=2, alpha=0.5)+ xlab(xLabel) + ylab(yLabel)+ labs(colour=legendTitle))
    }else if(graphType=="pie"){
      c <- ggplot(dataFrame, aes(x=graphX,fill=graphX),environment=environment()) + geom_bar(width = 1)
      print(c + coord_polar(theta = "y")+ xlab(xLabel)+ylab(yLabel)+ labs(fill=legendTitle))     
    }else if(graphType=="violin"){
      c <- ggplot(dataFrame, aes(graphX,graphY),environment=environment())
      print(c + geom_violin(aes(fill = xVariable))+ xlab(xLabel)+ylab(yLabel)+ labs(fill=legendTitle))     
    }else if(graphType=="scatter"){
      c <- ggplot(dataFrame, aes(xVariable,yVariable),environment=environment()) + xlab(xLabel)+ylab(yLabel)
      print(c+ geom_smooth() + geom_point())
    }else if(graphType=="plotmatrix"){
      dataFrame <- dataset
      customRowNames <- dataFrame[,1]
      rownames(dataFrame) <- NULL
      rownames(dataFrame) <- customRowNames
      sub <- subset(dataFrame,select=-c(Indicators))
      c <- plotmatrix(sub)
      print(c)
    }
  }
 
  plotCombination <- function(){
   
    customDataFrame<- dataFrameSubsetByIndicators()
    drawGraph(graph(),dataFrameSubsetByIndicators(),NULL)
  }
 
  histogram <- function() {
    # generate histogram for Totals for the grouping of each indicator
    Hospital <-data$hosp
    Malaria_Cases <- data$mal_tested_pos
   
    drawGraph("hist",data,Hospital,"Site",Malaria_Cases,"Malaria Cases","Site")
  }
 
  pie <- function() {   
    # generate pie chart for Totals for the grouping of each indicator   
    output$siteName <- site
    if(site() !="All"){     
      if(graph()=="hist"){
        subsetData <- subset(data, data$hosp==site(),drop = FALSE)
        Respiratory_Rate <-subsetData$resp_rate_rcd
        drawGraph("hist",subsetData,Respiratory_Rate,"Respiratory Rate Recorded",NULL,"Record Count","Recorded?")
      }else{
        subsetData <- subset(data, data$hosp==site(),drop = FALSE)
        Respiratory_Rate <-subsetData$resp_rate_rcd
        drawGraph("pie",subsetData,Respiratory_Rate,"Respiratory Rate Recorded",NULL,"Record Count","Recorded?")
      }     
    }else{
      Respiratory_Rate <-data$resp_rate_rcd
      Recorded <- factor(Respiratory_Rate)
      drawGraph("pie",data,Respiratory_Rate,"Respiratory Rate Recorded",NULL,"Record Count","Recorded?")
    }   
  }
 
  box <- function() {
    # generate boxplot for Totals for the grouping of each indicator
    Acidotic_Breathing <-data$acidotic__breathing
    Respiratory_Rate <- data$resp_rate
    drawGraph("box",data,Acidotic_Breathing,"Acidotic Breathing Present",Respiratory_Rate,"Recorded Respiratory Rate","Present?")
  }
 
  violin <- function() {
    # generate violin plot for Totals for the grouping of each indicator
    Acidotic_Breathing <-data$acidotic__breathing
    Respiratory_Rate <- data$resp_rate
    drawGraph("violin",data,Acidotic_Breathing,"Acidotic Breathing Present",Respiratory_Rate,"Recorded Respiratory Rate","Present?")
  }
 
  timeSeries <- function() {
    Weight <- data$weight
    Age_Years <- data$age_years
    drawGraph("scatter",data,Weight,"Weight",Age_Years,"Age in Years")
  }
})

How would I be able to achieve that?
